name: funnel-refresh
description: Cloudflare Worker that regenerates the Amari staff funnel snapshot (cohort funnel: calls / gifted sessions / session-sales valued in sessions sold) from live GHL event data and writes it to PORTAL_KV. Cloud replacement for the local ~/.claude/ghl-mcp/funnel.mjs + LaunchAgent. STAGED: writes funnel:latest-test until cutover.
